hypothesis: Authenticated R8 REDUNDANT delivery is compared fairly with both single-path controls under the same scheduled flap and application load, without claiming inferred physical disjointness.

pairing.comparison: paired differences within the same topology seed and flap target

blocking.randomization: randomize paired mechanism execution order within each topology-seed block

trigger_and_readiness.trigger: one precisely scheduled one-second flap after steady state
trigger_and_readiness.no_flap_control: executed under the same topology and load controls
trigger_and_readiness.recovery: recorded from the scheduled flap through post-flap delivery recovery

controls.trust: the same preconfigured closed-lab trust material and peer authorization policy for all paired members
controls.load: identical application bytes, application rate, MTU, and queue settings
controls.topology: topology evidence retained for every topology seed
controls.timeout: identical per-trial timeout recorded before execution

timeout_and_censoring.censoring: timeouts remain raw failures and censored recovery observations; they are not substituted with successful values
timeout_and_censoring.degraded_rule: periods degraded to one path remain in raw results and are labeled and excluded only from claims of active redundancy
